title: Neon API key: one-property twin (boundary)
summary: 1 input is identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is cut, extended or delimited so that it no longer ends where the format ends. Legacy mutation notes: boundary: napi- vs the provider-documented napi_ delimiter. Twin of "Neon API key: must be flagged (tool-corroborated) [legacy tier T2]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of neon-api-key-export: boundary: napi- vs the provider-documented napi_ delimiter. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
